summary.text: William Joseph is the Republican candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 88, in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists him as a business owner and president.
In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a district resident of more than three decades.

paragraphs.text: Joseph graduated from Oxford Academy, according to Ballotpedia.
In the survey, he said he is 55, is married with three children, is a licensed professional in investigations and as a fugitive agent, and has owned and operated multiple businesses in the district.
He also said he has served on three boards.
Joseph said his campaign's cornerstones are workforce housing, community entertainment, family support, safer neighborhoods, economic growth, value for artists and high-quality education.

sources.title: William Joseph - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey
